geometry_series: parent s=0 and rigid Ag-subsystem translations s=-0.20,+0.20 A
method_control: same fixed cell, PBC, k mesh, cutoff, smearing, PAW setups, SCF thresholds and boundary treatment within each termination
common DFT target pending A mesh/boundary/energy review
native extrapolated energy and force-consistent free energy reported separately

energy.normalization: report per cell and divide once by projected contact area |a x b| in eV/A^2
energy.absolute_interface_energy_requirement: matched separated-framework and Ag references with identical atom counts, cell, PBC/vacuum and numerical method; never compare raw total-energy zeros

forces.outward_normal: unit normal from cross(a,b), oriented to have positive dot with cell c
forces.rigid_Ag_generalized_force: G_Ag(s)=sum_{i in all four Ag atoms} F_i dot n
forces.marked_pair_diagnostic: G_pair=0.5*(F_Ag-F_X) dot n for persistent marked Ag and termination atom
forces.all_atom_vectors: retain all force vectors in persistent atom-ID order; report matched-geometry RMS and maximum vector changes
forces.force_energy_source: GPAW forces are force-consistent with free energy at finite smearing; do not compare them to native-energy derivatives

finite_step_checks.reported_residual: central secant minus mean endpoint rigid-Ag force; finite-step O(h^2) truncation applies
finite_step_checks.symmetry: report DeltaE(+h)-DeltaE(-h) separately for native and free energies; do not assume it vanishes

required_per_case: parent and proposed input hashes, method and PAW hashes
actual interface gap and marked-pair distance
native/free energy per cell and per area
net Ag-subsystem outward force and marked-pair projected force
all-atom force vectors in stable ID order, plus RMS/max differences
interpretation_limits: Do not infer elastic constants without stress/strain response.
Do not infer equilibrium gap or interface strength from three unrelaxed static points.
Do not claim independent validation: AgC, AgSi and AgTi share one CIF bulk parent.
No DFT was run; all six geometries remain disabled until A review and explicit registration.
